pr.title: chore(cockpit): certify unknown drift queue primitives
pr.body:
## Summary
- certify that the existing Unknown / Drift Queue runtime primitives satisfy Phase 1 blocker 4 on the current integration base
- preserve the existing non-executable queue, no runtime reclassification, five top-level modes, and Claude Design blockers
- record current-base proof without changing runtime behavior

## Strict scope
- no final screens
- no Claude Design upload
- no runtime action execution
- no T4 remote mutation
- no live service adapters
- no canonical writes
- no Unknown / Drift execution
- no runtime reclassification

## Governance state
safe_for_claude_design: NO
READY_FOR_CLAUDE_DESIGN: not approved

## Validation
See closeout proof for command outputs and exit codes.

## Residual risks and downstream packets
- inventory regeneration against current HEAD remains a separate packet
- queue items are aggregated where accepted artifacts expose counts rather than per-row data
- remote-mutation policy remains absent, so T4 stays refused
- promotions, demotions, and reclassification remain packet-owned outside the runtime renderer

steps.task: Inspect repo authority, accepted package/runtime/settings artifacts, Safe Action, Palette, IA handoffs, and current Cockpit runtime surfaces before implementation.
validation: Dedicated worktree is verified from claude/hungry-buck-67a0d3 at the audited SHA.
Accepted package, runtime-render, and settings-runtime proof artifacts parse.
Missing root authority files and schema files are recorded as UNKNOWN rather than inferred.

steps.task: Implement deterministic Unknown / Drift Queue taxonomy, item model, aggregated builder, and allowed display-only affordances.
validation: Reason taxonomy contains all required reason codes.
Queue item defaults are non-executable, non-reclassifying at runtime, and packet-required.
Secret-like values are redacted in labels, details, and evidence references.

steps.task: Extend runtime-render text and JSON snapshots with Unknown / Drift Queue summary fields while preserving existing modes and Settings/Admin/Runtime output.
validation: Unknown / Drift Queue is represented as a secondary/global surface, not a sixth top-level mode.
Snapshot includes counts by reason, source surface, owner packet, stale proof, index drift, Settings/Admin unknown tier count, source artifacts, and blocked governance state.
CLI runtime-render output includes the Unknown / Drift Queue summary and still fails closed without explicit --runtime-render and --package-dir.

steps.task: Add focused tests and proof artifacts for the Unknown / Drift Queue primitive layer.
validation: Boundary greps pass without forbidden positive claims or runtime call tokens.
Proof output is written only under the allowed unknown-drift proof/out paths and records validation evidence.
